long_biography.plain_text:
An advertisement introduced Dave Tan to Richard Mille’s watches in 2002. Already experienced in the watch trade, he contacted the magazine and met Mille in Basel. He initially questioned whether an unfamiliar brand could command such prices, then developed a retail approach centred on direct relationships with its buyers.

Tan also initiated the St. Martin concept boutique in Singapore after securing its premises. He wanted the rooms to reflect Mille’s interests and personality. The resulting space was designed for clients to visit with their families, with informal areas for spending time together beyond the watch displays.

confidence.reason: His actual 2014 interview supports the introductory meeting, scepticism and direct-client retail strategy. Alexandre Mille's actual interview explains Tan's premises initiative and the family-friendly design purpose, without asserting property ownership or measured customer outcomes.
